chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Aban ibn Uthman from Humran ibn A'yan said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Talbiyah, so he said to me: 'Intend Hajj with the Talbiyah. When you enter Mecca, perform Tawaf around the House, pray, and then exit the state of Ihram (Ihlal).

key_terms.أَحْلَلْتَ: You exited the state of Ihram (freedom from restrictions)
key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةِ: The declaration of intent and praise for God during Hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the correct way to recite the Talbiyah and perform the initial rituals of Hajj according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Istibsar, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the practical application of the Talbiah, linking it directly to the transition from Ihram to the state of freedom (Hillal) upon completing the initial Tawaf and Salat al-Hajj. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the sequential nature of Hajj rituals, where the completion of specific acts within Mecca marks the end of the major Ihram restrictions for the pilgrim.
